components.notes: Next.js app. CI copies .env.dev.example to .env, starts docker-compose.dev.yml (Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, MinIO), runs pnpm turbo run build:test, migrations (golang-migrate for ClickHouse), starts Langfuse (pnpm run start) and then runs the server vitest projects; client (jsdom) tests run separately with pnpm run test-client and need no services; Playwright e2e (test:e2e) and Storybook tests run in other jobs.

@langfuse/shared (Prisma schema, ClickHouse queries, server code). CI runs db:generate then tests with a Redis service container; SQL-equivalence golden tests need the clickhouse binary (installed from packages.clickhouse.com) and skip without it.

Queue worker. CI starts docker-compose.dev stack, builds worker..., migrates and seeds Postgres and ClickHouse, then runs vitest excluding LLM-connection tests (those need provider API keys and run only on path changes).

Rust service (toolchain pinned 1.98.0 in rust-toolchain.toml); CI runs fmt, clippy, cargo machete, cargo deny, cargo test --locked, then builds and smoke-tests its Docker image. A separate test-ai-gateway-e2e job exercises it through web.
napi-rs Node addon in Rust (toolchain 1.98.0); pnpm test runs cargo test. Tested in the 'typecheck and native checks' job.
